summary: Policy submission stuck in 'Processing' after 2025.2 upgrade
description: Underwriters report new business submissions in PolicyCenter hang indefinitely in Processing state. Started immediately after the 2025.2.1 upgrade was deployed to production last night. No error visible to end users, but app server logs show repeated GosuRuntimeException in PolicyPeriod.bind().
resolution_notes: Root cause was a Gosu rule override (UWApprovalRule.gs) referencing a deprecated API method removed in 2025.2.1 (PolicyPeriod.getLatestPeriod() renamed to getLatestBoundPeriod()). Patched the custom rule, redeployed, cleared stuck submissions via batch script. Confirmed with Guidewire release notes GW-RN-2025-2-1-004 which documented this breaking change.

summary: Second wave of stuck submissions, same symptom as INC-100234
description: Additional underwriting team reporting identical hang on bind. Same deployment window.
resolution_notes: Duplicate of INC-100234. Same Gosu rule fix applied once patch rolled out to remaining app servers.

summary: Nightly batch job ClaimReserveRecalc failing with timeout
description: ClaimReserveRecalcBatch has failed for 3 consecutive nights. Job exceeds the 2-hour SLA window and is auto-killed by the scheduler. Claim volume has not changed significantly.
resolution_notes: Found a missing index on cc_claim.cg_lastreservedate after a DBA-led table partitioning migration last week. Added composite index (claim_id, lastreservedate). Batch runtime dropped from 3h10m to 22m.

summary: Invoice generation job silently skipping accounts with autopay
description: Monthly invoice batch completed with 0 errors reported, but ~1,200 autopay accounts received no invoice. Discovered by finance reconciliation, not by monitoring.
resolution_notes: The autopay filter condition in InvoiceGenBatch.gs used an outdated boolean field (cg_autopayenabled_legacy) instead of the new cg_autopayenrollment entity introduced in BillingCenter 2025.1. Config change to point filter at the new entity. Recommending a monitoring alert on invoice-count-vs-active-accounts going forward.

summary: Duplicate contact records created after sync with external CRM
description: Integration job from Salesforce into ContactManager is creating duplicate Contact entities instead of matching existing ones when email address has different casing (John@x.com vs john@x.com).
resolution_notes: Matching logic in ContactMatchSet was case-sensitive on email. Applied config change to normalize email to lowercase before match. Ran de-dup batch script to merge ~340 existing duplicates.

summary: Users intermittently logged out every 5 minutes
description: Multiple users across regions report being logged out of PolicyCenter roughly every 5 minutes since this morning. No recent deployment on our side.
resolution_notes: Traced to SSO identity provider session token TTL being reduced from 60 to 5 minutes by the IAM team during an unrelated security hardening change. Not a Guidewire defect. Coordinated with IAM to revert TTL to 60 minutes for the PolicyCenter service principal.

summary: Auto rating returns incorrect premium for multi-car discount
description: QA flagged that policies with 3+ vehicles are not receiving the multi-car discount since the 2025.2.1 rate table update.
resolution_notes: Rate routine MultiCarDiscountRule.gs had an off-by-one error in the vehicle count comparison (used > 3 instead of >= 3) introduced during the rate table refactor. Code fix deployed and backtested against 50 sample quotes.

summary: Outbound claims payment file to bank rejected - format error
description: Daily claims payment extract to the bank's SFTP has been rejected for the last 2 runs with a format validation error on the payment file.
resolution_notes: Bank changed their fixed-width file spec (field 14 widened from 10 to 12 chars) per their advisory sent 2 weeks ago to a distro list that didn't include our team. Updated IntegrationGateway mapping template to match new spec. Added bank advisory distro to our change-notification subscription.

summary: Customer portal shows misaligned button on mobile Safari
description: The 'Pay Now' button on the billing page overlaps the due-date text on iPhone Safari after last week's UI release.
resolution_notes: Pure CSS flex-wrap issue in the new responsive billing component. Cosmetic only, no functional impact. Fixed padding rule and redeployed static assets.

summary: ClaimCenter UI extremely slow during peak hours
description: Adjusters report 10-15 second page loads on the claim summary screen between 12pm-2pm daily for the past week.
resolution_notes: APM traces showed N+1 query pattern in the new ClaimActivitySummary widget fetching related activities one-by-one instead of batching. Code fix to use a single batched query. Page load dropped to under 1.5s under load test.

summary: User asking why invoice total doesn't match quote - expected behavior
description: Agent opened a ticket saying invoice amount is 'wrong' but amount correctly includes a mid-term endorsement premium change.
resolution_notes: No defect. Explained proration logic to agent and linked existing Billing Proration FAQ runbook. Closed as user error.

description: Complete PolicyCenter outage across all regions. All app server threads blocked. MIM bridge opened.
resolution_notes: Thread dump analysis showed deadlock between the new audit-logging interceptor (added in 2025.2.1) and the document-generation service under high concurrency. Rolled back audit-logging interceptor via feature flag as immediate mitigation; permanent fix tracked as a vendor-escalated defect (case GW-88213) with a patch expected in 2025.2.2. RCA-2025-041 filed.

summary: Follow-up question on PolicyCenter outage RCA
description: Ops lead asking for confirmation the audit-logging feature flag rollback is holding steady post-incident.
resolution_notes: Confirmed stable for 24h post-rollback. No action needed, informational closure referencing RCA-2025-041.

summary: Users unable to log in - license limit reached
description: New hires in the call center cannot log into ContactManager, getting 'no license available' error.
resolution_notes: Concurrent user license pool was exhausted by orphaned sessions from a prior VPN outage that never cleaned up. Ran session-cleanup script to release stale licenses and requested a license headroom increase from Guidewire account team as preventive measure.
